get.summary: Own direct chat model-get

200.description: Principal-bound direct-chat result; incognito transcripts are volatile.

profile.description: The chat's own choice; null: it routes like any chat without one (defaultProfile or task class).

reasoning.description: A chat's reasoning / thinking intensity on the harness scale (cheapest first), or default: send nothing and let the provider decide. Each attempt maps it onto the model's own levels (nearest supported) and wire parameter.

items.description: One configured model profile a chat may pick, described by its primary model. A locked profile stays listed with selectable false and the reason (local-only: Nur lokal is on and a candidate is not local; unavailable: the catalog no longer lists the model).

reasoning.description: What the primary model offers. kind none: no setting (the model reasons on its own or not at all). source: the provider's own model list (api), the curated table (table) or nothing known (unknown).

503.description: The audit log could not record the grant, so there is none (`reason`: `audit-unavailable`).

504.description: The handler did not answer in time (`reason`: `handler-timeout`).

bearerAuth.description: A personal API token, `plb_<id>_<secret>` (`POST /api/v1/tokens`). Needs no CSRF token. Acts with the caller's role narrowed by the token's scopes; never holds a human-only action.
